title: The project_not_registered hint names ward init where init cannot run; readBoundedFile has no O_NONBLOCK
description: Two items from the Opus review of ward-cli#267 (WCLI-140), both predating it and outside it. (1) The project_not_registered hint "Run ward init in a terminal to register this checkout" (src/contract/errors.ts) is also shown at a checkout where ward init fails with checkout_identity_unavailable (pruned worktree git directory, invalid nonce file, unwritable git directory): the same truthfulness question WCLI-140 L1 settled for the doctor report, on the error path. A new or reworded error needs an opum-doc ruling as an A/B draft. (2) readBoundedFile (src/adapters/checkout.ts) opens without O_NONBLOCK, so a FIFO swapped in between the lstat and the open could block the read. It needs a same-account attacker, outside ADR 0002, so treat it as hardening only.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The project_not_registered hint no longer sends the developer to ward init where init cannot run, as ruled by opum-doc
readBoundedFile cannot block on a swapped-in FIFO, or the item is closed as accepted residual with a note

implementationNotes: Item 2 (readBoundedFile) implemented on fix/WCLI-144-hint-and-nonblock, local only, not pushed, waiting on the opum-doc ruling for item 1 so the task stays one PR. readBoundedFile now opens O_RDONLY|O_NOFOLLOW|O_NONBLOCK and refuses a descriptor that is not a regular file; it is exported so a test can reach it. Test: a child process (killed at 5s, so a regression fails rather than hangs) reads a regular file as the control, and a FIFO with no writer, expecting an undefined read at once. Controls: removing O_NONBLOCK makes the FIFO test fail at 5.0s; removing only the fstat isFile guard does NOT turn it red on this platform (the non-blocking read of a writerless FIFO already throws), so the guard is defence in depth that no test pins. Item 1 (the project_not_registered hint) is an A/B sent to the leader: A reword one static hint to point at checkout_identity_unavailable first (recommended), B choose hint or error by an identityBindable probe at each raise site.

Item 1 implemented per DEC-255 (a11), option A (opum-doc ruling relayed by the leader; record opum-ai/opum-doc#1616): the project_not_registered hint stays one static string and now reads "Run `ward init` in a terminal to register this checkout. If init reports that it could not give the checkout an identity, fix what that error names first; init cannot register the checkout until then." The message is unchanged; option B (probing identityBindable at every raise site) was rejected. Pinned by an exact-string test in test/checkout-identity.test.ts. One PR with item 2 (readBoundedFile, noted earlier).
